action_summary: The residual priced by the round filed 20261201 is a syntactic alias, not one bit of user language. A computed quotient derives U(c) <=> M(c) AND F(c,k+1) from integer counts, unit increments and the initial reading, applies it to 29,890 statements over 555 executed runs, and shrinks the user's goal class from two minimal statements to one with zero questions. A fourth machine that starts with one copy separates the pair and is correctly refused a merge.
